text:
Alex M: quick shout — new org coming online next week (acme-edge). Need a focused preflight for cross-cloud GPU provisioning + networking edge cases. Primary: GCP (europe-west4), AWS (eu-west-1), Azure (northeurope).
Sana R: SG. main pain points: regional GPU availability (A100/V100), per-region vCPU & GPUs quotas, private IP limits for nodepools, and NAT gateway egress costs.
Devon (infra): also watch default service account/key permissions — we should lock down SA scopes and use dedicated service accounts per env. roles: `roles/compute.admin`, `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser`, `roles/compute.networkAdmin` at minimum.
Irene G: tagging & billing first: ensure billing account attached and org-level cost-center tags. For Azure use management groups + costCenter tag; GCP/ AWS need labels and billing export.
Alex M: can someone paste a minimal checklist snippet? want exact asks we submit to cloud support for quota increases.
Sana R: minimal quota asks per region: `GPUS` by type (A100: 32, A10G: 50), `CPUS` (extra 500), `INTERNAL_IPS` (per-subnet 2500 -> 10000), `NETWORK_LOAD_BALANCER` limits bump. For GCP add `SSD PD` IOPS if heavy logs.
Devon (infra): example gcloud request body: ```
gcloud compute project-info set-quota --resource=GPUS --limit=32 --region=europe-west4
``` but we'll use support console for batch requests. For AWS open a support case for "EC2 GPU instance quota" listing `p4d`, `g5` counts and per-AZ capacity.
quota-bot: Current quick check: GCP europe-west4 GPUs available: A100(0 remaining), A10G(12 remaining). AWS eu-west-1 spot capacity: intermittent for p4d. Recommend early reservation (Dedicated) for production. Link: https://internal.quota/dashboard/acme-edge
Irene G: network: reserve secondary ranges for nodepools (k8s pod IPs). Example: `10.20.0.0/19` for pods, `10.20.32.0/20` for services. Request subnetwork secondary range increase from netops.
Alex M: ops action items: 1) Sana submit GCP quota ticket for A100 and internal IPs; 2) Devon open AWS limit request + check AZ capacity; 3) Irene attach billing & tags; 4) I'll draft terraform IAM SAs.
Sana R: submitting now — will paste case ID here. Case: 2026-GL-9821. ETA from support 3 business days.
Devon (infra): AWS case opened: #6789412 — asked for g5/ p4d increases and soft-limit AZ allocation. Also asked for recommended placement groups for low-latency inference clusters.
Irene G: adding network ops: @CloudOps Bot please create ticket to increase VPC secondary ranges and bump NAT gateway throughput for eu-west-1 to avoid egress throttling.
CloudOps Bot: Ticket created: NET-2026-114 (VPC secondary ranges + NAT throughput). Assigned to netops-team. ETA 2 business days.
Sana R: cost note — if we go Dedicated (reserved capacity) estimate ~30% cheaper than on-demand for sustained inference. Preemptible/spot ok for dev only.
Alex M: good call. for prod we'll request Dedicated pools in Dedicated offering and pin model versions. Devon, can you draft a short runbook for fallback regions (if eu-west A100 sold out)?
Devon (infra): will do. fallback rules: prefer nearest region same continent (north-europe -> ireland), fall back to smaller instance type with auto-quantization. Add health-check route in runtime to switch model routing.
Irene G: I'll push required tags and billing export to bigquery: `billing.acme_edge` dataset.
Alex M: thanks all — once quota replies land, we'll schedule a 30-min rollout preflight. :thumbsup:
Sana R: ping me if support asks for justification numbers — I'll provide expected vCPU/GPU hours per month and cost projection.
Devon (infra): adding checklist reminder: enable Stackdriver/CloudWatch agent + node-level GPU metrics, and ensure KV cache eviction policies set to avoid OOM.
Alex M: perfect. closing thread for now, will reopen when support replies come in.
